title: The Distant Protocol Again
author: Jonah Brightwater
blurb: Bram Coldharbour, a terraformer tending a garden meant for people not yet born, has spent seven years hauling cargo through contested orbits. But when a distress signal arrives in a language extinct for two centuries, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now he must prove a massacre happened when every record says otherwise, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
